reason: The autoticket build's new-error report was silently dropped because its payload used the key `active`, which dispatch's collector reads as its own flag. Nothing in the module tests caught it; only an end-to-end run through dispatch signals did. No existing skill covers module signal payloads.

A module that checks a person's setup and finds it broken now reuses dispatch's generic setup-not-working signal instead of printing errors or banners. Recording the payload, clear, and delivery mechanics next to the existing signal rules keeps future modules from inventing a parallel path.
